title: Default theme: dark OLED
question: Which OLED dark should be the default? (View with the gallery in dark mode)

variants.label: Lifted panels
variants.notes: Sidebar and content sit on near-black panels lifted from the black background; cards one step lighter. True black #000 background, brighter section colours tuned for black, no grey lines. These stay OLED even if the gallery is in light mode.

variants.label: All black, colour only
variants.notes: Everything is black; only the section colours and very dark fills give structure. Most OLED, most contrast. True black #000 background, brighter section colours tuned for black, no grey lines. These stay OLED even if the gallery is in light mode.

variants.label: Layered greys
variants.notes: More visible grey layers on black: easier to tell panels apart, less pure. True black #000 background, brighter section colours tuned for black, no grey lines. These stay OLED even if the gallery is in light mode.
